notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around a standard federation restore-request failure. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of the requesting federate's restore-request failure callback, exact save-label delivery, absence of restore-start callbacks, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with requestFederationRestore and FederateAmbassador requestFederationRestoreFailed delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and restore-request declarations
